pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal dark regions, primarily quadrilateral and pentagonal in shape. Edges exhibit high-contrast, sharp pixel gradients on the central flank, with slight softening of gradients toward the ventral region.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous negative-space network of light-colored pathways. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-radiate. Pixel thickness is consistent across the primary flank, representing approximately 10-15% of the total surface area compared to dark patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrated 1D contour visible along the upper neck line, creating a jagged silhouette against the out-of-focus background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small birds (likely Buphagus species) perched along the dorsal ridge and lateral neck area.
